baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction makes al-basar the subject of bariqa, with both the eye and its faculty of sight available.
baseline_models.mechanism: The startled-stare branch of ب ر ق and the ocular branch of ب ص ر converge on a sensory organ arrested by shock: the eye opens, fixes, and no longer blinks or scans.

activation_trace.role: The eye's startled fixed stare supplies the loss of blinking and active scanning that drives the model.
Physical seeing locates the arrest in the eye or visual faculty rather than in an unattached idea.

changed_reading.after: When the eye is startled into a fixed, unblinking stare.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Bariqa can predicate visible gleaming of al-basar itself, not only fear experienced by its owner.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sudden gleam saturates or appears in the visual faculty, making the eye both receiver and visible register of an abrupt light event.

activation_trace.role: Lightning-like flash and visible gleam supply the abrupt luminous event.
The eye's faculty of sight provides the medium that receives and visibly registers the gleam.

changed_reading.after: The visual faculty itself is struck through with, or visibly gives off, a sudden flash.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun al-basar remains the anchor, while the ب ص ر inventory also carries inner sight, certainty, and self-witness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The flash is tentatively cognitive as well as ocular: perception that had remained outward is forced into an instant of inward recognition and cannot look away.

activation_trace.role: Bewildered, unblinking fixation supplies the involuntary and inescapable quality of recognition.
Inner sight and self-witness permit a cautious shift from optical seeing to suddenly unavoidable knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Only an outer ocular event occurs.
changed_reading.after: The stunned sight may also mark discernment flashing into unavoidable inward certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The subject wills to break open what lies ahead and asks when the rising will occur; the answering fa-idha does not provide a date but arrests his forward-projecting organ in an unblinking present. The eye becomes an event-clock whose failure answers the temporal question experientially.

activation_trace.role: The fixed stare supplies the abrupt arrest of forward-directed visual agency.
Ordinary sight is the faculty converted from projection toward what is ahead into involuntary presence.
Will and intention supply the subject's active projection toward a chosen future.
Wide splitting and outburst give that projection the force of trying to break the way ahead open.
The spatial image of what is in front makes the desired future a direction of movement and gaze.
Questioning and requesting frame the demand for a knowable temporal answer.
A duration of time supplies the category in which the questioner expects the answer.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour identify the event whose timing is being pressed.

structural_cues: 75:5-7 moves directly from willing ahead, to asking when, to fa-idha and the failed gaze.
The response replaces calendrical information with a bodily event sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future-directed willing, a when-question, and the immediate fa-idha; I infer that ocular arrest is the functional answer that converts projected time into experienced present, while the live alternative is that verse 7 merely begins an unrelated event list.

changed_reading.before: A person's eye freezes at an unspecified crisis.
changed_reading.after: The person asking for a future date is forced into an unblinking present, and his own eye becomes the answer to when.

context_deltas.mechanism: The eye's fixing is coupled to a recession of celestial light and the forced gathering of the two luminaries. A branch of خ س ف explicitly carries recession of the eye, allowing the lunar event and ocular event to mirror one another as local and cosmic apertures losing their normal light-order.

activation_trace.role: Lightning-like gleam supplies the last abrupt light event registered in the eye.
The physical visual faculty provides the local light-register paired with the sky.
Recession of the eye supplies a direct branch bridge from the moon's loss to ocular withdrawal.
The moon and its light supply one celestial pole whose normal visibility collapses.
Joining what was separate turns the two light sources into a compressed, disordered visual field.
The sun supplies the second and stronger celestial light pole drawn into the collapse.

structural_cues: 75:7-9 is one uninterrupted fa-idha/wa/wa sequence linking eye, moon, sun, and moon.
The scale expands from one visual faculty to the architecture that normally makes vision possible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ocular gleam, eye-recession imagery, extinguished lunar light, and gathered luminaries; I infer a coupled eye-sky system in collapse, while the alternative is a simple list of independent portents.

changed_reading.before: An individual eye is dazzled by an external catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: The eye becomes the bodily register of a cosmic light-collapse, mirroring the recession and forced conjunction occurring in the sky.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact sight root returns as basirah predicated of the human against his own self. The following act of casting excuses, with excuses also carrying a curtain image, makes the inward sight function as an involuntary witness that self-screening cannot cover.

activation_trace.role: Unblinking fixation makes the recognition involuntary and prevents a figurative looking away.
The focus root's inner-sight branch allows the physical gaze to carry a latent self-knowing function.
The self as the thing's own identity makes witness and witnessed belong to the same bearer.
Inner sight, certainty, and explicit self-witness activate the inward force latent in the focus noun.
Throwing something outward gives the excuses the mechanics of a deliberately placed cover.
Excuses as curtains supply the screening image that reflexive sight remains able to defeat.

structural_cues: 75:14 repeats ب ص ر in an explicit self-relation after the crisis sequence.
75:15 immediately tests that self-witness against the production of excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact sight-root recurrence, self-identity, and cast excuse-curtains; I infer that the focus gaze turns reflexively upon its bearer, while the live alternative is that basirah is solely forensic testimony with no feedback into the earlier eye.

changed_reading.before: The stunned eye only fails to process an outer scene.
changed_reading.after: The fixed sight also becomes an uncovered inward witness, forcing the bearer to see what his own excuses cannot screen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prohibition on self-generated motion and haste is followed by a controlled sequence of gathering, recitation, following, and disclosure. Against that sequence, the fixed eye can be read not only as blank panic but as the cessation of autonomous scanning before an ordered, imposed reception.

activation_trace.role: The fixed unblinking stare supplies the stilling of self-directed perceptual motion.
The visual faculty becomes the receptive channel whose ordinary scanning has stopped.
Motion opposed to stillness supplies the explicit action that must cease.
Hastening and premature advancement identify self-timed reception as the blocked mode.
Gathering dispersed parts supplies the first imposed operation after haste is checked.
Reading and recitation supply the ordered content that replaces autonomous motion.
Following behind supplies the receiver's responsive rather than initiating role.
Appearance and unveiling make the end of the reception sequence perceptual disclosure rather than emptiness.

structural_cues: The same fa-idha construction reappears at 75:18 before the command to follow.
75:16-19 orders cessation of haste, gathering, recitation, following, then disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stopped motion, checked haste, and an ordered reception sequence; I infer that the focus eye's arrest can analogically mark compelled receptivity, while the alternative is that 75:16-19 is a separate address with no ocular resonance.

changed_reading.before: The frozen gaze is only perceptual breakdown.
changed_reading.after: The frozen gaze can also be a forced receptive state in which self-timed scanning stops before an ordered disclosure is received.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later faces divide into radiance directed toward a viewed object and a grim, nearly arrested surface anticipating a back-breaking event. The focus branch in which contrasting colors gather, explicitly extending to the eye, turns the initial flash into the first compressed bodily display of those divergent orientations.

activation_trace.role: The gathering of black and white or two contrasting colors, including in an eye, supplies a split visual field.
Physical sight anchors that contrast in a bodily organ rather than an abstract color scheme.
The face as the forward surface makes inner orientation externally legible.
Beauty and radiance supply the bright pole of the embodied contrast.
Directing sight or insight toward an object gives the bright face an oriented gaze.
Scowling and severe aversion supply the dark opposing facial pole.
Certainty formed from a sign makes the grim appearance an anticipatory reading of what approaches.
A calamity that breaks the back supplies the expected force shaping the darkened face.

structural_cues: 75:22-25 presents two face states in parallel, one radiant and looking, one grim and anticipating.
The eye event at 75:7 is the surah's first concentrated bodily response before those full-face outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed face states, gaze direction, and anticipated impact; I infer that the focus eye compresses this later bodily contrast into an initial threshold-sign, while the alternative is that the face portraits classify separate groups and do not unfold from the earlier gaze.

changed_reading.before: The eye suffers a morally neutral burst of visual overload.
changed_reading.after: The eye becomes the first bodily surface on which opposed orientations, radiance toward and grim recoil from, begin to register.

context_deltas.mechanism: A second idha sequence tracks arrival at an upper bodily limit, breath-associated ascent at the clavicle, separation, limbs wrapping together, and final driving. This turns the fixed eye into the first visible point in a serial transfer from self-directed agency to a body being carried along.

activation_trace.role: The eye's immobile stare supplies the earliest externally visible failure of voluntary control.
The physical eye anchors the transfer model in bodily function.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the irreversible threshold in the bodily sequence.
The clavicle as a place where breath ascends materially links the call for a raqin to the upper-body boundary.
Distinguishing and separating supplies the recognized break from the prior embodied state.
One thing wrapping around another supplies the limbs' loss of independent action.
Driving and herding supply the terminal replacement of self-motion by imposed movement.

structural_cues: 75:26 repeats idha and begins a body-level progression from the collarbones to wrapped legs and the final masaq.
The root ت ر ق at 75:26 is retained only as a branchless structural cue for the throat or collarbone boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated idha, an upper-body limit, separation, wrapped limbs, and imposed driving; I infer that the eye-freeze is the first stage of the same loss-of-agency cascade, while the alternative is that 75:7 remains a cosmic prelude and 75:26 starts a separate dying tableau.

changed_reading.before: The gaze freezes as a generalized sign of eschatological terror.
changed_reading.after: The gaze freezes as the first visible threshold in a bodily process that strips self-motion and ends with the person being driven.

context_deltas.mechanism: The empty-flash branch of ب ر ق becomes active against a subject who fails to make truth effective, denies, turns away, and extends his body in swagger. At the crisis, managed outward display reverses into an involuntary ocular sign that exposes rather than conceals.

activation_trace.role: An empty flashing display with no substance supplies the model of performed appearance.
Self-witness allows the involuntary eye to disclose what the performed exterior had hidden.
Making a promise or claim real in action, here negated, supplies the absent substance behind display.
A garment that lies by its outward condition supplies a concrete image of deceptive presentation.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the attempted bodily evasion.
Swagger through extending the body's bearing supplies the controlled public pose that will be reversed.

structural_cues: 75:31-33 moves from failed truth-act to denial, turning away, and a visibly extended swaggering gait.
The focus and later swagger both make the body a public surface, but only the former is involuntary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated truth-making, deceptive appearance, withdrawal, and swagger; I infer a reversal from controlled display to involuntary disclosure through the focus eye, while the alternative is that the empty-flash branch is inactive and bariqa denotes fright alone.

changed_reading.before: The eye is simply frightened by what appears.
changed_reading.after: The subject's managed exterior collapses, and the eye involuntarily publishes what denial, withdrawal, and swagger had tried to conceal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the specialized 'human image in the pupil' branch rather than the ordinary noun insan; it remains anchored through the focus eye, the later insan/self/basirah construction, and exact ب ص ر recurrence. Downstream prose should present it only as a branch-level optical metaphor for reflexive witness, not as the syntax or lexical gloss of either ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-basar is a physical seeing organ whose fixed flash can expose an image within the pupil rather than only an object outside it.

activation_trace.role: Visible gleam makes the pupil a suddenly illuminated surface.
The physical eye provides the bounded site in which the reflected human image can appear.
The human image in the black of the eye supplies the unusual reflexive optical mechanism.
The thing's own self identifies the reflected and witnessing human as one bearer.
Inner sight and self-witness turn the optical reflection into a contained model of self-recognition.

changed_reading.before: The eye only receives an overwhelming external scene.
changed_reading.after: The flashing pupil can be carried as an optical image of the human becoming visible to himself inside his own organ of sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 75:7 does not explicitly narrate reanimation and the model reads nonadjacent construction language materially; it remains anchored in the focus pairing of visible gleam with physical sight and in the surah's repeated gathering, fine bodily equalization, complete formation, life, and death. Downstream prose should qualify it as a nonchronological functional analogy, not claim that the ayah locates the instant of resurrection's first blink.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combination of a visible gleam and an embodied visual faculty can mark the return of function in a reconstructed body.

activation_trace.role: Visible gleam supplies an outward sign that the visual system has become active.
Physical sight supplies the specific embodied function whose return would be visible.
Joining dispersed parts supplies the reconstruction operation.
Straightness and completion in the thing itself supply restored bodily integrity.
Extremities of the limbs make the promised reconstruction fine-grained rather than generic.
Complete formation and balanced bodily shape supply the developmental counterpart to reconstruction.
The living, ensouled creature supplies the state in which restored sight functions.
Departure of power and life supplies the prior state from which function must return.

changed_reading.before: The flash is only a reaction of a continuously living observer.
changed_reading.after: The flash may be carried as the first visible return of perceptual function in a body whose dispersed and minute structures have been restored.

strongest_changes: The when-question was answered by an embodied present: the forward-projecting gaze itself became the event-clock.
The eye and sky formed a coupled light-system, with ocular recession, lunar loss, and gathered luminaries making the gaze a local register of cosmic collapse.
The exact ب ص ر recurrence at 75:14 converted outer visual failure into involuntary self-witness that cast excuse-curtains cannot cover.
The repeated idha and the throat-to-driving sequence made the fixed eye the first visible stage in a terminal transfer away from self-motion.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a repeated reversal from projection, haste, scanning, turning away, and swagger into fixation, following, disclosure, wrapped limbs, and imposed driving. It also preserved odd but anchored optical branches, especially the pupil's human image and the eye's contrasting-color field, that a single consensus gloss would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The inward self-witness reading is strongly activated by 75:14, but it remains uncertain how much of that later basirah should be read back into the concrete noun al-basar.
The receptive-stilling model depends on treating the repeated fa-idha and 75:16-19 reception sequence as a functional echo rather than a wholly separate discourse.
The return-of-visual-function outlier is a material analogy across the surah and should not be converted into a chronological claim about 75:7.
